summary:
H.R. 8580, the Military Construction, Veterans Affairs, and Related Agencies Appropriations Act, 2025, appropriates funds for fiscal year 2025 for military construction, the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), and related agencies. 

Title I appropriates funds for Department of Defense (DOD) military construction and family housing across the military departments, reserve components, and defense-wide activities, generally available until September 30, 2029. It includes transfer authorities and reprogramming guidelines (Sec. 117, 122). Section 124 appropriates additional funds for projects on unfunded priority lists, subject to prior authorization and submission of an expenditure plan within 60 days of enactment. Section 133 prohibits funds for the closure or realignment of U.S. Naval Station, Guantanamo Bay, Cuba.

Title II appropriates funds for VA operations, including Veterans Benefits Administration, Veterans Health Administration (VHA), National Cemetery Administration, and departmental administration. It provides advance appropriations for fiscal year 2026 for Compensation and Pensions and Readjustment Benefits. Section 233 authorizes use of Medical Services funds for fertility counseling, assisted reproductive technology, and adoption reimbursement for certain veterans with service-connected disabilities. Section 246 restricts VA research using canines, felines, or non-human primates, requiring specific Secretary approval, certification of scientific necessity, and reporting, with a phase-out deadline of March 9, 2026. Section 255 prohibits funds for abortions except in cases of rape, incest, or life-endangering physical conditions. Section 256 prohibits funds for gender affirming care. Section 257 restricts flag displays at VA facilities.

Title III appropriates funds for the American Battle Monuments Commission, U.S. Court of Appeals for Veterans Claims, Arlington National Cemetery, and Armed Forces Retirement Home. Section 301 appropriates special account funds under 10 U.S.C. 7727 for Army National Military Cemeteries.

Title IV contains general provisions. Section 412 prohibits DOD funds for constructing or renovating facilities in the U.S. to house Guantanamo detainees. Sections 414, 415, 417, 418, 419, and 420 prohibit funds for specified executive orders, Critical Race Theory, diversity, equity, and inclusion training, COVID-19 mask mandates, and climate-related executive orders. Section 421 prohibits VA procurement of computers or software from entities with Chinese ownership or ties to the Chinese Communist Party defense industry. Section 423 establishes a Spending Reduction Account of $0.
